task: Investigate 34 actual Stage21 quality-D1 STOP cases against full cohort, using official Binance aggressor-side Spot aggTrades that had occurred BEFORE first D1 signal

source_provenance.source_data: Binance official daily Spot aggTrades CSV in ZIP plus .CHECKSUM published SHA-256, 2025+ microsecond timestamps

timing: Strictly event timestamp in [signal_ms-60minutes,signal_ms); never include same millisecond or future trades. Class labels from original Stage21 exits only. No new trading rule or threshold derived by looking at labels.
trade_direction: Binance m=true (buyer is maker) means seller aggressor; m=false means buyer aggressor. AggTrade is aggregate at same price/taker, does NOT represent raw independent execution count or full orderbook depth.

validation.cohort_comparisons: STOP vs TAKE_PROFIT vs TIMEOUT with distribution medians, no posthoc tuned cutoff or unbiased p-value

falsification: If pre-entry taker-side composition fails to distinguish STOP from other historical valid exits, or sources are insufficient, label this feature family inconclusive/rejected; do not deploy or retroactively choose thresholds
next_stage_after_diagnostic: If signal-side imbalance exhibits credible research signal, separately freeze a causal rule and run on different, previously unused full 758-symbol dates, measuring profit and miss rate, before independent other-AI review
